decision: The experimental CreateProcessInSandbox API rejects inherited handles and therefore does not establish the selected stdio MCP route. A non-experimental STARTUPINFOEX + PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_SECURITY_CAPABILITIES AppContainer launch with a restricted handle list is a candidate for an owned-fixture trial, subject to user authorization and actual denial/communication evidence.
proposed_fixture: Separate explicitly owned Git and no-Git directories under this worktree's TestResults/T015-AppContainer-<nonce>; trusted parent precreates each .codegraph entry, then grants child package SID source/runtime read and contained .codegraph descendant write. No child root creation, no network capabilities, only intended MCP stdio handles, owned kill-on-close job and cancellation.
outside_declared_footprint: Windows AppContainer profile and redirected LOCALAPPDATA/TEMP/TMP under per-user LocalAppData/Packages/<identity>/AC; exact actual path and cleanup are unknown until trial and require separate authority before creation.
launcher_precaution: Set CODEGRAPH_NO_DOWNLOAD=1 in addition to planned telemetry/watch/daemon/update flags; fail closed if pinned platform bundle resolution changes.
unverified: Node and pinned CodeGraph startup under exact ACL
child token propagation and job cleanup
actions_taken: Read-only API/package/host inspection only; no fixture, AppContainer profile, ACL, process, network, tracked source, or CodeGraph state was created.
